text:
alex: quick FYI — noticed two anchors in runtime-onboarding that 302 -> the old docs garden when viewed via the staging preview. Japanese localized page also links back to the ENG snippet. unsure who owns that page, can someone claim and do a tiny fix? :wave:

tori: thanks for the flag. can you paste the broken links or a screenshot? staging preview URL + example anchor would help.

alex: yep — staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime-onboarding?preview=1
anchor examples: `#getting-started-quickstart` and `#api-examples`. both resolve with a 302 to garden shortlinks. no screenshot yet, i can grab one.

jen: i can take this. looks like a shortlink drift — likely a redirect mapping gone stale. if it's small i can open a PR to point to the internal canonical anchors. who can review? @kevin?

kevin: i can review. if it's just frontmatter/canonical change and a couple link edits, i can do a quick pass. ping me once the PR is up. :+1:

alex: uploaded a quick curl to confirm the 302s:
```
curl -I "https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime-onboarding#api-examples"
```
response shows `HTTP/1.1 302 Found` and `Location: https://garden.redwood.ai/...`

linda: heads-up — some localized pages were backfilled from garden snapshots last year, so ownership might live under `docs-localization` or whoever claimed that page. jen, when you open the PR, add a note in the PR description about localization implications so we don't regress translations.

jen: good call. plan: 1) quick scan for other anchors using grep, 2) patch anchors in runtime-onboarding and the ja page, 3) add an internal redirect in shortlinks if needed. grep i'll use: `rg "#(getting-started|api-examples)" -n docs/ | sort -u`

alex: another quick helper if people want to batch-replace anchors:
```bash
# replace old garden shortlink targets with canonical anchors in-place (dry run first)
rg "garden.redwood.ai" -n docs/ | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u | xargs -I{} sed -n '1,200p' {}
# then a sed replace on files you want to patch
sed -i.bak 's|https://garden.redwood.ai/old-path#api-examples|/runtime-onboarding#api-examples|g' path/to/file.md
```

deploy-bot: Staging preview build 2026-05-12T14:06:00Z for branch `docs/patch/anchor-fix` completed — preview available at the same staging URL.

jen: opened PR #4321 with the two anchor fixes and a note about ja localization. added `@kevin` for review and `@linda` for localization confirm. small change, should be fast.

kevin: reviewing now. left one nit about an unrelated trailing slash in a sample link, but LGTM after that.

linda: looked at the ja page — the links are mapped, but translations don't need edits. confirmed. thanks for the PR, jen.

alex: awesome, thanks all. can someone merge once kevin approves? i want the staging preview to return 200s for those anchors before the next docs sweep. :pray:
